explication: dd-trace-java is Datadog’s Java APM client: it automatically or manually traces and profiles Java applications, with additional CI Visibility, AppSec, telemetry, and related capabilities. The principal workflow is application activity being instrumented, represented as trace data, and sent to Datadog; profiling and other product features are parallel branches. The README establishes these capabilities, but most runtime wiring was not sampled, so uncertain relationships are shown as dashed and uncited.
